verdicts.rationale: Both members: 'Focusing and background operators', von Stechow, 1991, same DOI and booktitle.
Both identical: Markman, 'Categorization and Naming in Children', 1989, same ISBN.
Both 'Real-time nonphotorealistic rendering', same author list, same SIGGRAPH '97 DOI.
Both 'Conditional reasoning with causal premises', Quinn & Markovits 2002, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both La Roche-Cotard Neanderthal engravings paper, identical author list and DOI.
Both 'Cooperative Computation of Stereo Disparity', Marr & Poggio 1976, same DOI.
All three are Marr's 'Artificial Intelligence: A Personal View'; marr1981artificial is the Mind Design (1981) reprint of the same 1977 work.
Both fields describe 'Analysis of occluding contour', Marr 1977, same DOI/vol/pages; the marrnishihara citekey label is misleading but the bib fields match.
All three 'Representation and recognition of the spatial organization of three-dimensional shapes', Marr & Nishihara 1978, same DOI.
Both 'A computational theory of human stereo vision', Marr & Poggio 1979, same DOI.
Both 'Visual information processing...', Marr 1980, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both 'Directional selectivity and its use in early visual processing', Marr & Ullman 1981, same DOI.
All five identical: 'Vision', Blake & Marr, 1983 review in Am. J. Psychology, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both 'Representation and recognition of the movements of shapes', Marr & Vaina 1982, same DOI.
Both 'Plutarch', Martin & Gianakaris 1971, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both 'Dispositions and Conditionals', Martin C.B. 1994, same DOI/vol/pages.

All five 'The Limits of Self-Awareness', Martin 2004, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both 'The value of a real face...', Weiß, Mussel & Hewig 2020, same DOI/vol/pages.
Both 'Conversational Maxims and Some Philosophical Problems', Martinich 1980, same DOI.

Both 'Autopoiesis and Cognition', Maturana & Varela 1980, same DOI.
Both 'Feature-based attention in visual cortex', Maunsell & Treue 2006, same DOI.
Both 'Conjoint Representations and the Mental Capacity for Multiple Simultaneous Perspectives', Mausfeld 2003, same DOI.
All three 'Animal signals', John Maynard Smith, 2003, same ISBN.
